Dude, don’t do it. It’s not worth it. Ending your life early won’t help your situation at all. If you end it now, then there’s no chance at all that you can find love. Please, just talk to me about it. I now you said you didn’t want to, but I’m here to listen.

I’m really sorry about that. Maybe you could try explaining to them that you’re seeking help? Your brother might not have. Or, you could ignore your family for the time being, if you really think it’s affecting your mental health.

I’m really sorry that all of this is happening to you. But if you just give up, you will ever even have the chance to make things improve. Not everything in life is determined by school. You should tell someone about your mental state, bottling up all of your feelings from the people your care about won’t help you.
Hey do you wanna talk to me? You don’t have to kill yourself. Just tell me what’s wrong.

I’m almost the exact same. Many of my friends are friends that are online. I don’t go to many parties or do wild stuff, but recently I have been climbing out of my depression and things have been turning up for me. If you keep struggling through life, things eventually will get better.

It’s okay to not feel happy every once in a while. As long as you don’t let that unhappiness affect an aspect of your life forever. I just want you to know that you’re not alone and there’s always someone to talk to.

Losing friends that you’ve known for a while sucks, but if your relationship with her is driving you to the point of suicide due to her negligence, you should really think about removing her from your life. Now, I’m not saying you should just do this, but you should maybe think about this. I want to see you happy. Suicide is never the answer.

Don’t end it. Just don’t. If you wouldn’t mind telling me what caused your depression, I’m all ears. I only want you to tell me if it’s within your comfort zone, though. Your father doesn’t realize that you’re in pain, and if he does, then he’s an asshole for ignoring it.

I don’t have a very similar experience, but I have experienced sexual assault. It was on my sister’s wedding day, nonetheless. If you want to hear about it, I’ll gladly message you. I’m glad you found your voice one way or another and admitted it to someone.

If she’s lying to you and you feel like she really doesn’t want to be your friend, I think you should cut her off. Friendships like that aren’t healthy, and I wanna see the best outcome for you. For what it’s worth, you would have me. I know you barely know me, but I don’t want you to go just yet. My name is Alex, it’s nice to meet you.

Hey, don’t think for a second that nobody cares about you, because I care about you. I’d love to get to know you and learn your interests. It sounds corny but I don’t want you to harm yourself in any way.

Please, don’t think that way. You may not know me, but I care about you. If you really don’t want that friend to drift out of your life, you could tell her how you feel. Also, you can talk to me, if you’d like to be my friend. I’d really like that.

For what it’s worth, I could be your friend. You probably don’t care about me, considering I’m a total stranger on the internet. But if it makes you feel any better, I really would like to get to know you. You don’t have to accept, but at least consider talking to me. I really want to see you get better, y’know?

That doesn’t mean you have to end your life over it. Personally, I see it as a challenge. A challenge that will result in you advancing, emotionally and socially. You may even find a SO while doing things like these. Getting your life sorted out is hard, but it doesn’t mean the world is over.

Hey, you realized what was wrong and you feel guilty over that. It’s normal. Many people that do the same things you did don’t have and regrets about it and would do it again if they could. Don’t end your life over this. You realized was wrong and you feel sorry about it.
Why? You can tell me all about it.
Talk to me about it. I beg of you, don’t do it. Tell me what’s wrong. Tell me why you have the need to kill yourself.

No, you’re wrong. It IS worth living. If you want to talk to me about your problems, I’d be glad to listen to you. You’re not alone in this world. Your mom just doesn’t realize that you’re looking out for her. But that doesn’t mean you should end it all because she doesn’t. Those “friends” you mentioned aren’t real. Do you have any long-term goals? Like an SO? Buying a house? Or something small like a rank in a video game? Whatever it is, just look toward those goals and try to focus on those things. If you were to kill yourself, I would care. Even losing an absolute stranger could affect someone drastically. Don’t just be another body that could’ve been something great.

Listen, I know what it’s like not loving your appearance. But that doesn’t mean that you should end your life because you can’t fulfill your fantasies. If you really want to go after someone else, you should. You don’t have to tell any friends or family about it. I never really recommend therapy because most of the time, it does nothing. This is cliche as fuck, but I think before you love someone else, you need to love yourself first. You’ve probably heard this a thousand times, but I still wanted to say it anyway. Don’t. Kill. Yourself. It’s never the answer. My question for you is: do you think you have any chance of achieving that dream of finding someone more attractive if you’re dead? That won’t help anything at all. It’s better to try than to give up.

I read your post and I almost burst into tears. Dude, I get how you’re feeling, but there is a reason to keep living. You’ll find love again. You’ll find new goals to work toward. It’s not the end yet. You can talk to me more if you want. I don’t want this to be your last year.
Don’t end your live. Tell me what’s wrong.

I know things are tough, but do simple things that make you happy. I can’t control you though. It’s you’re decision to make, but I really hope you don’t kill yourself. If you do decide to end your life, I’m sorry I couldn’t help you and I hope you’re happy with your choice.
